What a hub on v0.18.1 saves, with every field filled and every enum variant used at least once, and only fake values (`fake-…` ids, no real hosts or addresses). Generated by a throwaway test at tag `v0.18.1` (`git worktree add <tmp> v0.18.1`) that built the `Store` and the graph runs from that tag's own types and wrote them the way `Connectors` saves them (`connectors*.json` with `serde_json::to_vec_pretty`, `runs.json` with `serde_json::to_vec`). The generator is not in the tree; the test `connectors::tests::a_store_saved_by_v0_18_1_loads_with_nothing_dropped_or_reset` reads these files. Never regenerate them from a newer tag: they are what v0.18.1 wrote.

- `connectors.json`: the whole store. `connectors-box-variants.json`: the `BoxPermission` values the first has no slot for. `runs.json`: the workflow runs, one per pending effect plus a finished one.
- `linear.email` holds a placeholder, not an address.
- `connectors-box-variants.json` is loaded with no workflow ids, so only the value comparison catches a silent fall back to the default store. Keep its values different from `BoxAccess::default()` (workflow `fresh`, the others `off`): today `workflow`, `worker` and `orchestrator` differ; `session` is `off` only to use that variant, and the other three still catch the fallback.
